Market today: Tech and AI are buzzing. Strong earnings from Palantir and Snap, plus Microsoft's big run, show the market is warming up to AI spending. This is a tailwind for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.14%) and SPAL (-56.5%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses and decay; they need immediate review. SMH (-14.29%) and QQQI (-4.56%) are also near their stops and marked for trimming. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions for further downside. Also, watch for continued strength in large-cap tech, especially those with AI exposure.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your deeply underwater and leveraged positions; respect your stops.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are down over 50% and decay. Re-evaluate their place in your portfolio given the extreme losses and margin.
Respect stops on SMH (540) and QQQI (52): Both are marked for trimming and are very close to their stop levels.
Consider MSFT: Headline momentum and a scanner "WATCH" setup (entry 487.16-486.68, stop 485.95) suggest a potential long idea.
